# enrich\-amazon

```go
import "budget2/cmd/enrich-amazon"
```

Package main is the enrich\-amazon CLI: it reads an Amazon order\-history export, matches each shipment against the user's bank transactions, and writes data/amazon\_enrichment.json — a hash→label map that the dataloader applies on every load.

Usage:

```
enrich-amazon --amazon-dir ~/amazon-export [--data-dir ./data] [--dry-run]
```

The enrichment file lives alongside aliases.json so it inherits the same encryption\-at\-rest path. Re\-run safely: each run regenerates the full map from current Amazon data \+ current transactions.
